metadata.description: CloudBackend PaaS and XIOS/3 developer tooling for Claude: the published skills, five workflow agents, the documentation, build and tenant servers inside the plugin, and the per-tenant deploy connector.

plugins.name: cloudbackend
plugins.description: Build on CloudBackend PaaS with XIOS/3: the published skills (Singularity database, REST API, native SDKs, XIOS/3 applications and design, the SaaS launch path and the build-and-deploy workflow), five workflow agents, the documentation, build and tenant servers running inside the plugin (the tenant server signs you in in your browser and deploys), and the per-tenant deploy connector.
